subject: Amendment Required to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

Please review the draft Bill of Lading against the authoritative Shipping Instruction.
We have found discrepancies that require your immediate attention and correction.
The Consignee is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, but the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.
Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.
Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
